F&O most opened forms.description: Finance and Operations telemetry: the most opened forms (pageViews)

F&O slowest form loads.description: Finance and Operations telemetry: form loads by 95th percentile duration
body: | summarize ['Opens'] = count(), ['Avg (s)'] = round(avg(duration) / 1000, 2), ['P95 (s)'] = round(percentile(duration, 95) / 1000, 2) by name

F&O X++ exceptions.description: Finance and Operations telemetry: the most frequent X++ exceptions
body: | summarize ['Count'] = count(), ['Users'] = dcount(user_Id), ['Last'] = max(timestamp) by problemId, outerMessage

F&O custom events.description: Finance and Operations telemetry: custom events (trackEvent, data management jobs)
